value: US Government work (public domain); NREL technical report

Ramsden, T., Ruth, M., Diakov, V., Laffen, M. and Timbario, T.A. (2013). Hydrogen Pathways: Updated Cost, Well-to-Wheels Energy Use, and Emissions for the Current Technology Status of Ten Hydrogen Production, Delivery, and Distribution Scenarios. National Renewable Energy Laboratory, Golden, CO. Technical Report NREL/TP-6A10-60528, March 2013.

Targeted pass on the production block of each pathway summary figure (Figs 6.x.1, printed numbers as labels; repeated in Appendices A-J) plus Sect. 2 descriptions. Seven distinct production plants loaded (biomass plant repeats across pathways 4-7; Pathway 4 values used). Delivery, CSD/dispensing, vehicle and WTW results not extracted (out of scope). Reference = printed page numbers (PDF page = printed + 23). Costs 2007$ except coal-CCS in 2005$ (H2A v2 basis). Per kg values are per kg H2 produced; O&M and levelized cost per kg dispensed. Process efficiency is LHV-based (Sect. 7). Production-stage GHG figures are life-cycle (GREET, incl. upstream and grid electricity), so they went to other-values, not main. Capex per daily kg uses effective (capacity-factor-adjusted) capacity. Feedstocks given in mass/volume (biomass, coal, ethanol) went to flows; no energy SEC printed for them. H2A total capital investment taken as total-plant cost basis. Wind electrolysis figure 6.9.1 has no extractable text; values taken from Appendix I copy (p.235).
